data.body: **[P2] Preserve terminal records instead of replacing the global slot.** `_pending` is shared across all execution ARNs and statuses. After an exporter exceeds one drain timeout, a later warm invocation can replace an earlier `SUCCEEDED`/`FAILED` record before the worker claims it, permanently dropping that execution’s only on-complete record even if the exporter recovers. Coalesce only nonterminal snapshots for the same execution; retain terminal records in a per-ARN queue/map, and cover timeout followed by another invocation.
